name: Edge CDN
author: Edge Network

sections.description: Edge CDN delivers your WordPress site’s assets from a global network of thousands of edge nodes, reducing latency and improving resilience. Install this plugin to link your site to Edge CDN and accelerate content delivery performance.
sections.installation:
Before installing this plugin, if you do not already have an Edge account, create one online and deploy a CDN, following the instructions there. Take note of your CDN address.

Install and activate the Edge CDN plugin. CDN routing is not enabled yet – it must be configured.

Click Edge CDN in the menu to access configuration. Enter your CDN address, check Enabled, and click Save to fully activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How can I send feedback or get help with a bug?

The best way to report bugs, suggest features, or provide any other (non-security) feedback is by creating a GitHub issue. Before submitting a new issue, please search the existing issues to check if someone else has reported the same feedback.

Where can I report security bugs?

Email support@edge.network.
